items.title: 10.1 Uniform (har jagah ek jaisa) magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.1 in the book's order (PDF 230-232), with the Fig. 10.2 correction, Example 10.1 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Experiment (kar ke dekhna) se dekha gaya hai ke magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force lagti hai. Ek seedha conductor lein jis mein constant (steady) current beh raha hai aur jo uniform magnetic field ke perpendicular (90° par) rakha hai. Maan lein current kaghaz se bahar ki taraf hai, jise Fig. 10.2 mein ⊙ se dikhaya gaya hai. Current se banne wali magnetic field ki direction (rukh) bhi dikhayi gayi hai.

Jaise do magnets apni magnetic fields ke zariye ek doosre par force lagate hain, waise hi current wale conductor par us ki apni magnetic field aur bahar ki (external) magnetic field ke aapas ke asar se force lagti hai. Is force ki direction jaanne ke liye dono fields ka milna dekhein.

blocks.alt: Conductor ka sira samne se dikhaya gaya hai, us mein point batata hai ke current kaghaz se bahar hai. Yeh do pole blocks ke darmiyan hai: oopar S aur neeche N. Khari field lines N se S ki taraf oopar ja rahi hain. Neele circle (gol chakkar) anticlockwise teeron ke saath conductor ki apni field dikhate hain. Force F ka teer horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) baen taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Uniform magnetic field mein current wala conductor: current kaghaz se bahar aur force F (kitab ki Figure 10.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 10.2 mein N pole oopar aur S pole neeche chhapa hai. Magnet ke bahar field N se S ki taraf jati hai, is liye N oopar ho to field neeche ki taraf hogi, aur kaghaz se bahar current par force F = I L × B right (daen) taraf banegi. Text kehta hai force left (baen) taraf hai; yeh tabhi sahi hai jab field oopar ki taraf ho, yani S oopar aur N neeche. Isi liye humne poles is tarah banaye hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Check karein: conductor ki apni field (neele circle) anticlockwise hai. Daen taraf yeh oopar ki taraf hai aur bahar ki field (oopar) se mil kar mazboot hoti hai; baen taraf yeh neeche ki taraf hai aur bahar ki field ko kamzor karti hai. Is liye conductor baen taraf, kamzor field ki taraf, dhakela jata hai.

Current ki field aur bahar ki uniform field conductor ki right taraf ek doosre ko reinforce (mazboot) karti hain aur left taraf ek doosre ko cancel (khatam) karti hain. Result yeh ke conductor us taraf chalta hai jahan field kamzor ho, yani force baen taraf hai. Is tarah force F conductor aur magnetic field dono ke perpendicular hai. Current wale conductor par force ki direction Fleming ke left-hand rule se maloom ki jati hai. Rule yeh hai:

blocks.title: Fleming ka left-hand rule
blocks.text: Apna left haath is tarah rakhein ke pehli ungli (shahadat ki ungli) magnetic field ki direction mein ho aur doosri (darmiyani) ungli current ki direction mein; tab angootha force ki direction batayega.
Force ki direction right-hand rule se bhi maloom ki ja sakti hai:

blocks.title: Right hand rule
blocks.text: Right haath ki ungliyan current se magnetic field ki taraf chhote angle (kona) se moriye; khula hua angootha force ki direction batayega.
Fleming ka left-hand rule Fig. 10.3 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Left haath: angootha seedha oopar, Force; pehli (shahadat ki) ungli daen oopar ki taraf, Magnetic Field; aur doosri (darmiyani) ungli daen neeche ki taraf, Current. Teenon aapas mein perpendicular (right angles) hain; baqi do ungliyan mudi hui hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Fleming ka left-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 10.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon directions aapas mein perpendicular hain. Pehli ungli field (B) ki taraf, doosri ungli current (I) ki taraf karein; angootha force (F) batata hai. Fig. 10.2 par lagayein: pehli ungli oopar (field), doosri ungli aap ki taraf (current kaghaz se bahar); angootha baen taraf aata hai, yaani force baen taraf.

blocks.alt: Bar magnet: baen taraf S (hara) aur daen taraf N (surkh). Curved (mura hua) field lines N sire se nikal kar S sire mein wapas jati hain; teer N se door aur S ki taraf hain, aur lines ek doosre ko nahi kaatti.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 230): Bar magnet ki magnetic field lines (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field lines magnet ke bahar N se nikal kar S mein dakhil hoti hain. Jahan lines ghani (qareeb qareeb) hain wahan field strong hai, yaani poles ke qareeb. Lines kabhi ek doosre ko nahi kaatti.

Ab magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force ki amount (magnitude) nikalte hain. Experiment se dekha gaya hai ke force conductor mein current I, conductor ki lambai L aur bahar ki magnetic field ki strength (zor) B, teenon ke directly proportional (seedhe proportion mein) hai, yani in mein se koi bhi doguna ho to force doguni. Magnetic field ki strength ko magnetic induction B bhi kehte hain, aur is ki direction field wali hi hai. Is tarah lambai L, current I wale aur field B ke perpendicular rakhe conductor par force F yeh hai:
SI units mein k = 1 hai. Is liye,
Eq. (10.1) se B = F/IL milta hai, is liye B ki definition (matlab ka bayan) yeh hai:

blocks.title: Magnetic field ki strength
blocks.text: Magnetic field ki strength numerically (adad mein) us force ke barabar hai jo field ke perpendicular rakhe, 1 metre lambe aur 1 ampere current wale conductor par lagti hai.
B = F/IL se B ki unit bhi milti hai. B ki SI unit tesla (T) hai:
Yaad rahe ke magnetic induction vector quantity (direction wali amount) hai; is ki direction magnetic field ki direction hai.
Hum ek vector L bhi le sakte hain jis ki amount conductor ki lambai ke barabar ho aur direction current ke flow (behna) ki taraf.

blocks.alt: Ek hi point se vector B seedha oopar aur vector L daen oopar, B se angle θ par. Usi point se horizontal teer, L sinθ, L ke sire ke bilkul neeche khatam hota hai aur khari dashed line se us se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.4: L ka B ke perpendicular component (hissa) L sinθ (kitab ki Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: L ko do hisson mein torein: B ke saath wala hissa force nahi deta; sirf B ke perpendicular hissa L sinθ force deta hai. Is liye F = BIL sinθ. θ = 90° par poora L perpendicular hai (force zyada se zyada) aur θ = 0 par perpendicular hissa zero (force zero).
Ab agar conductor L magnetic field se angle θ banaye, to hum L ka sirf woh hissa (component) lete hain jo B ke perpendicular hai, yani L sinθ (Fig. 10.4). Tab Eq. (10.1) yeh ban jati hai:
Vector shakal mein Eq. 10.2 yun likhte hain:
Eq. (10.2) batati hai ke force sab se zyada (BIL) tab hai jab conductor field ke perpendicular ho, yani θ = 90°, aur zero tab hai jab conductor field ke saath (along) ho, yani θ = 0.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Zameen ki magnetic field taqreeban ek dipole jaisi hai, jaise Zameen ke andar ek imaginary (khayali) bar magnet rakha ho. Is magnet ka south magnetic pole geographic (zameen ke naqshe wala) north pole ki taraf aur north magnetic pole geographic south pole ki taraf hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ke andar imaginary bar magnet, geographic axis (dashed) se thora jhuka hua. Field lines dipole ki tarah Zameen ke southern hisse se nikal kar northern hisse tak ghoomti hain. Labels: oopar South magnetic pole aur Geographic North pole; neeche Geographic South pole aur North magnetic pole.
blocks.caption: Interesting Information (PDF page 231): Zameen ki magnetic field taqreeban dipole jaisi hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Imaginary magnet ka S sira geographic north ki taraf hai, isi liye compass ki sui ka N sira north ki taraf jata hai: unlike (mukhtalif) poles ek doosre ko khainchte hain. Magnetic axis geographic axis se thora jhuka hua hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.1
blocks.problem: 20.0 cm lamba taar jis mein 10.0 A current hai, 0.30 T ki uniform magnetic field mein rakha hai. Agar taar magnetic field ki direction se 40° ka angle banaye to taar par force ki amount nikalein.
steps: Taar ki lambai = L = 20.0 cm = 0.20 m (cm ko metre mein badla)
Eq. (10.2) mein rakhein: F = BIL sinθ = 10.0 A × 0.30 T × 0.20 m × sin 40°

blocks.prompt: 2 m lamba current wala conductor PQ 0.5 T ki magnetic field ke perpendicular rakha hai aur us par 1 N force lagti hai. Current nikalein (numerical 10.12; kitab mein number 7.12 chhapa hai). Uniform field mein current wale conductor par force ka formula nikalein (comprehensive question 10.2).
blocks.explanation: I = F/(BL) = 1/(0.5 × 2) = 1 A; is ki direction Fleming ke left-hand rule se milti hai. Formula: force I, L aur B ke proportional hai, F = kBIL, aur SI mein k = 1, to F = BIL. Agar taar field se angle θ banaye to sirf L sinθ field ke aar paar hai, is liye F = BIL sinθ, ya vector shakal mein F = I L × B.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force lagti hai: us ki apni field ek taraf bahar ki field ko mazboot aur doosri taraf kamzor karti hai, aur conductor kamzor taraf jata hai. Fleming ka left-hand rule: pehli ungli field, doosri ungli current, angootha force.
F = BIL (10.1); B = F/IL, unit tesla, 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹; F = BIL sinθ (10.2); F = I L × B (10.3); perpendicular par sab se zyada, field ke saath zero. Example 10.1: 0.39 N.
